first_pass_state_handoff.interpretation_limit: Control replay is vertex-exact. Python first-pass XYZ+normal replacement greatly reduces final tail but still has two >0.1 mm vertices. Exact official XYZ+normal replacement yields 43 outliers; six columns do not capture the full optimizer handoff and later nonlinear paths may differ, so this arm cannot by itself attribute remaining error to later C++ operators or hidden state.
